segments.text: If it's not caught in the wild, we won't eat it.
Did I not tell you to play scissors?
A true man should always put forth a fist.
We always lose because of you.
Can't you not trust yourself for once?
We play with a gentleman's conduct.
At this point in our lives,
we could more than afford to open our own pool hall if we wanted to.
Yet we act as if we are 18 year olds,
mouthing off expletives and putting everything at stake for the sake of a win.
From a person's birth to their present,
to continually watch over that one person...
What kind of feeling is it?
That girl seems to be enamored with you.
Driver, can you please pull over there for a minute?
So it is you, Teacher Seo.
Are you looking to hail a taxi or are you waiting for someone?
Both, but I'm having some difficulties.
Actually, my cellphone battery is depleted and I don't have any money on hand.
Then it seems you've met your savior.
Why crash into a standing car?
The person who crashed into us just now, was you?
It's embarrassing to admit, but he's a friend.
What are you going to do?
Do you know how expensive this car is?
Well, can you tell how much my car is worth?
No need to deal with insurance.
You can admit yourself to the hospital for show if you want.
Did you actually run into us on purpose?
If I didn't, then this girl would have been about to get in.
and you know that I won't flee.
You know that I'll provide compensation, so are we done here?
Please contact me once you've acquired the quote.
No matter how long you stand here,
no one will be more willing to take you away than me.
What exactly do you think you're doing?
How could you purposely run into them?
What is there to be touched about when you've wrecked their car?
I was referring to the fact that I came to retrieve you.
I am grateful to you for that,
but I am not paying for the damages.
Is this your attempt at seducing me?
Tae San and Se Ra are at home right now.
I was supposed to go on an overnight hiking trip, but it was cancelled at the last minute.
Let's go to a hotel then.
I am not trying to seduce you!
Just lend me 30,000 Won, (*30,000 Won = ~25 USD)
and drive me to my neighborhood as quickly as possible.
There's a sauna I go to often.
We can turn the heat up in the hotel room.
You can hang the room key on your ankle if you like.
From this moment forth, I will not spend another Won on Miss Seo Yi Soo.
Remember where we went when you were drunk?
Don't you need to inspect your car a little?
I'll go take a look at it now.
Allow me to formally introduce you two.
Although she has been injured, she is being very brave.
You've been here so often you seem comfortable here.
It's because I'm fatigued, all right?
That just proves that you like it here.
A woman with an intimate knowledge of my space is very sexy.
Considering my outfit today, there is nothing I can say to that.
So I entreat you to stop joking around and go home.
Why is it that everyone takes my words as jest?
Not once have I ever joked with you.
Then in this situation, do I say,
"For acknowledging my sexiness, thank you for you"?
Is that what I ought to do?
Is there a room service that enters as it pleases?
Kim Do Pal, are you inside?
Yes, I'll be working into the night.
I didn't want to disturb Yoon.
I just want to rest awhile.
With Me Ah Ri back, there hasn't been a day of peace.
You get on with your work.
I'll be working in the room.
What'd you come in here for?
This is the room I always use.
He's supposed to be at my house.
That means I can go home then.
Be sure to greet Tae San on your way out.
Apologize for hiding from him just now.
Kim Do Pal, where is the medication for headache relief?
In the drawer of the television stand.
Go lie down for a rest.
I'm going to take a shower.
I'm covered in dust from the construction site.
I was going home when I got a call from someone.
I've already suffered the filth for over two hours.
Kim Do Jin, are you really going to spend the night here?
Kim Do Pal, are you in the shower?
No, I was the cause of it.
Jung Rok just texted me saying that he wants a drink.
Do you want to tag along?
I have work that needs to be finished by today.
I'll leave you to your work then.
Just reminding you not to drink so much.
I love you very much, do you know?
Betty's accident must have made you crazy.
You stormed into a bathroom where a man is showering without thinking first?
I was worried about being discovered.
A woman's crisis is a man's opportunity.
Both the top and bottom of my outfit is insufficient.
I can't leave wearing such revealing clothing.
It's the middle of the night.
This woman is quite proficient at improvisation.
I don't want to burden you any longer.
You're demanding to leave at this late hour.
I cut it out from Me Ah Ri's photo album.
Are you finally realizing that I am truly in love with you?
I can call you a taxi at least, right?
Or would that be considered a burden too?
Give me a glass of Black Russian.
You told Jung Pal to call me.
Who were you with and what did you do?
I saw a woman's clutch the size of my palm.
She says she didn't want to be caught but her actions don't coincide with her words.
Why did you leave so soon?
If you waited till morning, you would've seen the sky, plucked a star.
Seen a mulberry leaf, picked a lover.
If you are willing to maintain silence about the events of today then sit down.
Who was the girl who was with him?
Since when did the twenty-first century become an era where toil is without payment?
It's not you I'm doing this for, but her.
You bastard, how could you do that to the car-
You were with Do Pal at the time of the accident?
resulted in a ruined vehicle and some money spent.
If you continue to contain this little secret of yours between the two of you,
I won't inform you when I go out to meet women.
When have you ever told us?
Is that what you call a threat?
I think you need to swallow another ring in order to recover your senses.
Anyways, this year, Jung Pal's birthday and yours are only four days apart.
One is in accordance to the solar calendar, and the other, the lunar.
How can you be found so lacking in intelligence?
What do you want to do?
Are we still in nursery school?
It's wise to do it together.
This is a God given opportunity.
I want to celebrate them individually.
Take off his ring and make him eat it again.
Shall I lock the door and close the bar down?
You rascal, how can you do this?
You must not want to live.
is that of the rainy season.
I think you need to be beaten until the dust flies on a rainy day before you wake up.
Im Me Ah Ri, wake up.
You went hiking dressed like that?
Those shoes look like they're mine too.
I had to leave suddenly while I was trying on the dress.
That's fine, but how can you come back at this hour?
I said I'd spend the night with Tae San because I thought you weren't coming back today,
I only came back because I knew Tae San wasn't here.
I saw him when I was passing by.
Seoul is quite small, isn't it?
Treating her this way makes you seem impertinent.
If I stay any longer, we'll fight.
If you walk out now, we're finished.
I was just looking for you.
I don't know if you remember me.
I'm Reporter Lee from "Golf and You".
My apologies, but I'm busy today.
Please contact my agent for any official statement.
Just a few words, is that so difficult?
You seem to be experiencing many setbacks recently.
Would you say that you are currently in a slump?
Word is that if you don't get some results,
your sponsorship contracts will be terminated after this season.
But then, when has my fame ever been based on my abilities?
It's my looks my career's built on.
I guess you don't know, but for sponsors,
maintaining your figure is more important than practicing golf.
That way, I'm still photogenic when swinging a club even though I'm only wearing a t-shirt.
Are you satisfied with today's statement?
Installing automatic convergence facilities in the waterway
puts too much pressure on the electrical grid.
The construction firm is requesting other options.
Okay, I'll think on it some more.
Kim Geon, show them the aerial view of Ice World.
What kind of unnecessary expenses is he trying to put us through now?
If we modify this side this way, we can have two separate slopes.
The 6th floor will be for advanced, the 4th floor for intermediate.
The current design isn't any fun.
For an indoor ski resort, the current design is fun enough.
Then, for the ski resort design, are we back to square one?
you've done it often enough since joining this team.
The client is satisfied enough with the prospect of even having an indoor ski resort.
With these two slopes, their satisfaction will double.
We've been doing this for years now.
When have we ever done only the bare minimum?
The island itself serves as the theme park and resort.
There, both swimming and skiing are available year-round.
A design of this caliber will already be considered a premium in all of Asia.
What is there to ameliorate in a design as unparalleled as this?
The presentation date is already scheduled.
Divide the slope and rework the design.
Hyung Gyu, Geun Hee, give your current projects to Team #2 and focus only on this.
Since she said guest and not client, it must be a woman.
Seeing that she came to the office, it's one of two.
He doesn't seem to be tired enough.
Our secretary must be more negligent than I expected.
I told her that I won't be making any scenes.
She's obsessed with those kinds of hysterical dramas.
really nothing more than a guest?
I thought that discussion was over.
Only the gifts you bought for me are mine.
That doesn't change whether we are together or apart.
Is the unrequited love going well?
A girl who refuses even shoes like these...
If these are her stipulations, then I intend to adhere to them.
So you're serious about this unrequited love?
I thought it was because you'd tired of me that we broke up.
I may not be a good man,
but at least I'm not a lying, discourteous bastard.
In laughing, I represent all the girls whose tears you have been the cause of.
a man whose heart does not belong to me is far worse.
Hopefully, that girl who is subject to your unrequited love will bring harm to your heart.
Tell her she has my support.
Hopefully, that girl who is subject to your unrequited love will bring harm to your heart.
So you are still capable of introspection.
Handle it right when the insurance company calls you.
I sent Attorney Kang to the hospital.
She'll wait to see the diagnosis before deciding on hospitalization.
Because you seem more apologetic than I.
What's going on between you two?
Does Me Ah Ri of the pretty eyes and nose know about this yet?
Kim Do Pal, put down your spoon.
Moreover, it was served by the second party to the first?
Two hundred million is an entire month of our employees' wages.
What do you want to eat?
When you've blown two hundred million?
How many times have I told you that we're not
doing some art project on government funding?
You're the only one creating any art, and I'm the one who sees nothing but money, right?
It wasn't for the sake of art.
He was hit by the glass cup that jerk threw.
The reason he's been sporting a band aid on his forehead for the past few days, was because of that?
It was only after that I realized what we'd lost.
Be thankful it was only two hundred million.
I'd do the same if it was 200 million or two billion.
Do you honestly think that's an acceptable excuse?
I ought to break his bones and @%$&!.
Can we really not get anything at all?
According to the degree of completion, it can be recovered for the completed portion of the draft.
Although the responsibility for the breached contract will have to be traced,
the two hundred million won't be possible in the long run, but the amount owed for the work done should be possible.
Come by my office when you have the time.
Have this guy tied up so that he doesn't cause any more problems.
Why are you saying this now?
To see if you were capable of any remorse.
Every step you take, I will strew flowers in your path!
Just wait till you get home!
Even if we win the arbitration,
that 200 million will be deducted from your wages on a 24-month installation plan.
You're not going to the gallery?
Baek Hae Joo sells water purifiers?
Can't you at least try to lie?
What do I do when you just admit it like this?
There's really nothing going on between us.
You just happened to buy twenty water purifiers from her.
Do you know who, in this entire world, I have the most difficulty seducing?
What makes you say that, Cheongdam Witch?
In this entire world, the one person I have difficulty seducing is my own husband!
Park Min Sook, listen closely to my words.
Stop writing the entire book on your own.
Yes, I bought the water purifiers.
But if she and I have the kind of relationship you're thinking, it wouldn't have been water purifiers.
I would buy her bags, buy diamonds.
I would probably have just bought her an entire officetel.
Instead, I bought her water purifiers.
She is no longer a woman to me.
If not a woman then what?
Just a divorced college classmate bringing up her children in dire financial straits.
Whatever you're worried about, it won't happen.
Having aided her to this extent, she won't be contacting me again.
If there's anything else, just ask.
Did you buy a replacement ring?
No matter how far your imagination is running,
If you come any closer, we're getting a divorce.
It doesn't look like the boss is coming.
Now that I'm here he has nothing to worry about.
One mango kiwi and one mango coconut.
That'll be eleven thousand eight hundred won.
I'll deliver them to your table.
So that I can see him.
It's better that I take it for you.
What did you just do to me?
I was just taking the buzzer.
I just bumped into her slightly.
If I've hurt you, I'm sorry.
You need to watch your words.
Are you really going to cause all this fuss while in uniform?
Are you really going to view me as a patient?
Manager, may I leave half an hour early today?
Did that customer really hit you?
Can you please just let me leave early this one time?
I need to go look for it.
I was locked in the washroom at the bar yesterday.
I've just come out after finding it.
You didn't have a dime on you.
I started a Seo-inbad version of Sinbad's adventures even he would have been ashamed.
Which we can agree was all caused by you.
It was you who stopped in front of me.
Speaking of which, where are you going?
A class can go on without a student,
but it absolutely cannot be without a teacher.
I'm asking you where you're going!
Are you not going to class?
We've been meeting quite often, Teacher.
Weren't you going to the nurse's office?
I wanted to take a detour.
If we have any sense of pride,
we'll go back the way we came.
He said he'll be back in a while.
Can you get me something to drink?
There's something you need to see.
Her picture turned out very nicely though.
Field Fairy Hong Se Ra Values Figure Over Golf Practice
Which rotten magazine is behind this?
The number you have dialed is unavailable...
Why aren't you answering your phone?
At least tell me where you are.
Are you unable to reach her?
I'd thought she might come for a few drinks because of that terrible article.
She must have gone someplace else.
Do you know where Se Ra usually goes?
It's usually Sang Woo, Pro Park, and the other members of her team she's with.
Otherwise, it'll be Min Hyuk or Tae ll.
Why aren't you answering your phone?
Are you avoiding my calls on purpose?
What do you think you're doing, not answering the phone.
You must be drinking right now.
How many times is this now?
Why do I need to run around like an idiot trying to find you?
Whoever's with you, just wait till I catch them.
I'm going to kill them all today.
Why are you here all alone?
Why aren't you answering your phone?
Didn't we agree to stop meeting?
I was worried you'd seen it.
You don't need to verify it.
This should be more important to you right now.
At least let me see what they've written.
What kind of rotten news is this?
What did the phone do wrong?
That's all you need to know.
Did the insurance company call yet?
Attorney Kang's car required a small fortune in repairs.
A man's passion is worth quite a sum.
What exactly does Teacher Seo see in you?
She's never said she likes me.
Simply put, it's an unrequited love.
Teacher Seo has not yet accepted me.
So you run into someone else's car?
Well I can hardly run into her.
How are you different from a school kid flinging
rubber bands at the girl he likes?
Others I can't be sure of, but you are in no position to criticize me.
How bold and courageous she is.
Yet you refuse to pull her in or push her away, just leave her standing in the same position.
The 2011 amendment of the Trademark Law,
can you find out what the changes were?
Also, a female employee from the cafe on the first floor was here just now.
No need to send tea in.
I have no time for your games.
I'm not here to play games either.
I want to formally raise charges again Attorney Kang.
My wages will go towards the bill in its entirety without abatements.
That woman really did hit me.
That woman is the one who's lying.
Is it because that woman is amongst the women you've slept with?
Why are you always taking her side?
Because reason is on her side.
Why would Attorney Kang hit you?
Why did I just kiss you?
the daughter of a wealthy family...
Does that make any sense from a rational standpoint?
Who allowed you to do such a thing?
Do you need a scolding before you'll listen?
Am I an elementary school child who's scribbled all over your books?
Why are you treating me like a child?
If you truly detest me, then formally reject me as the twenty-four year old I am.
Never in front of you, have I ever been a child.
How good of you to arrive...
I just lightly bumped into you.
If I've hurt you, I'm sorry.
I must have been exercising too much lately.
Is this all the work you've prepared?
There are few more pieces in production.
Please wait a few more days.
How much longer will the wait be?
Representative Park, are you not clocking off yet?
This is the artist who will be exhibiting her work at our gallery, Ah Mi Seong.
Representative, you must be so happy together.
I see him every day, so...
I don't know why he's come all the way here though...
I missed you so I came to pick you up.
Or you've done something to feel guilty about.
I saw that you purchased a hotel fitness club membership for twenty-five million?
Me Ah Ri has the facts wrong.
There's a 10% discount, so it's 22 million.
You said you liked men with good bodies.
Other women also like men with good bodies.
And my husband, who has a good body, likes other women.
I am out of the equation.
If I withdraw the membership now, I won't be able to get a full refund.
Do you really think the money is my primary concern?
Do you really love me so dearly?
I love myself dearly, because you will be the death of me!
A gym membership is a must for promiscuous men.
It serves as a ready alibi for screening calls.
It's a reason for any change in underclothes, and a recent shower.
So I can do all those things?
You've dared to raise a hand against your God-like husband?
Have you forgotten that this is my gallery?
Who would dare say a word?
How is it this waist is still so minuscule?
Just try to attempt violence again.
You have been my reason for being of late...
President Kang is definitely a man.
He weights 100kg with a height of approximately 185 cm.
What if it's really from a man?
I'm telling you to hand it over.
If a person says that it really isn't then you should just believe them.
Can you really not just believe me like that?
If there is no trust between us, then how will we pass our days?
What kind of marriage is this?
This time, you are really in the wrong.
President Kang may live for you alone...
But today, it seems you will die for his sake.
You can transfer all the data and contacts from inside, right?
It's a good thing we met.
You have a spare room, right?
Let me stay a few days.
Please finish as soon as possible.
Your sister's the reason I'm in this mess!
Do you have something to say?
You're overlooking a very important fact, Me Ah Ri.
I know when Yoon will come, and when he will go.
I can also call him over.
you want me to be a double spy?
If you save the time spent keeping me on surveillance,
you'd have time to look in a mirror, right?
Don't let Yoon oppa come here for the time being.
Don't you want him to come every day?
Her beauty's finally blooming after much difficulty.
You said you'll treat me to dinner, but I still haven't received a call.
How do you know I work here?
I must have told you while I was drunk.
Do you remember saying you'll treat me?
To be honest, my memory's still muddled, but I'll treat you anyways.
I do remember you rescuing me.
I must have been so heroic at the time.
Please sit over there to wait.
I'll be leaving half an hour early.
The one who saved me at the club.
Why is he staring at me like that?
Doesn't he look like he used to run with a gang?
Is he younger than Me Ah Ri?
Since she met him at the club, he can't be too bad a person.
Im Me Ah Ri is no ordinary girl.
She's a miniature Park Min Sook.
You ought to be worried about that guy.
You don't want anything to drink?
Even if it's just me drinking, are you not willing to pay?
I ordered this especially for you.
My Japanese friends all love sha-bu sha-bu (Japanese hotpot).
Why is your name Colin when you live in Japan?
That's because I was born in the United States.
I told you all that at the club already.
Why don't you address me with honorifics?
I never said I was twenty.
Even if I don't abstain from alcohol, I'd better abstain from clubs.
I'm not involved with anyone, but there is someone I like.
You must really think yourself beautiful.
Those men just now, what is your relationship with them?
I've known them all my life.
To me, they're still immature college students.
To others, they must be a couple of middle-aged men.
What is this 'you' to someone older?
This is a country of courteous Eastern etiquette.
Why are you curious about my brother's name anyways?
You haven't even asked my name yet.
The moment he first slides on the gloves,
he'll find that the person who gave him those gloves is lovely,
and will want to grasp her hands.
The person who went with you to the baseball field last week?
Did you have trouble finding the house?
Thanks to you, Yi Soo, we're going on our first date today.
I wasn't even aware that the two of you were in contact.
That's why I warned you against looking.
Tae San said he's bringing a new phone over.
But I wanted to ask you...
Have you ever seen me date men with no money to their name?
You were like that even without knowing?
You became friends without knowing that?
You were Me Ah Ri's homeroom teacher.
Don't you do those home evaluations these days?
Me Ah Ri or Tae San,
the clothing they wear have the value of a middle-sized automobile.
So that's the way it is...
No, I'll go out to buy it.
To get some air while I'm at it.
I was about to knock when the door flew open.
How surprised do you think I was?
I gave the rules you set regarding unrequited love some thought.
So, you've prepared a gift that's under a hundred thousand won?
They're even more expensive than the last pair.
So I purchased them on a 14-month installation plan.
That's an average of a hundred thousand per month.
That's the best compromise I could come up with
between the qualities of shoes I want and the rules you've dictated.
I don't have the occasion to wear such extravagant shoes.
Then don't wear them to be extravagant.
When you come to me, come to me wearing them.
When the weather's nice, dress up prettily.
What are you saying to another man?
I was coming out to meet you, but you're already here.
Would someone care to explain what's going on here?
This is the jacket I gave you.
That's why I thought she was you.
It's true, I really thought she was you.
I wanted to surprise you, but I never thought that it might be Yi Soo.
Looks like this jacket was the problem.
What kind of architect has such poor visual dexterity?
Don't go spreading this around now.
Who would have thought that your clothes would be worn by Yi Soo?
Am I the only one who is confounded by this?
You must be even more flustered with Pro Hong appearing too.
Don't be too angry at him.
Although I know it was a misunderstanding,
I'm still too aware of it.
I still feel as though Tae San is behind me.
As though, I am still in his embrace.
If the problem is in the clarity of the memory,
Now that that memory's been replaced with an even more distinct vexation.
Were you really unaware or are you just feigning ignorance?
How can that possibly be true?
The picture of you that Yi Soo has in her planner.
The set of gloves embroidered with your uniform number that Yi Soo has hidden beneath her bed.
It looks those gloves were supposed to be a present.
While you're here, you might as well take them with you.
Or did you know and secretly savor it?
Quit the sarcasm and get to the point.
What do you really want to know?
There is nothing more I need to know.
Confirmation that Yi Soo's 'twenty second man' was you, Im Tae San, and still is.
What do I want to know?
I want to know what your feelings are.
It doesn't look like those words will be coming out your mouth.
Yi Soo's 'twenty second man' was you, Im Tae San, and still is.
Has someone appeared with a child?
By any chance, is it cancer or anything of the like?
Have you been to the hospital?
Relying on the back view alone,
I mistook Yi Soo for Se Ra and hugged her.
The back hug all women like?
Seung Taek, open up another bottle.
Looks like our VIP guests are upgrading to VVIPs today.
I've decided to begin a one-sided love affair.
My unrequited love, Miss Seo Yi Soo.
That was a newlywed bride's line.
If you must ask what crimes I've committed,
it was to have met her, fall in love with her.
Leaving her alone every night is my greatest sin.
May I ask, are you very wealthy?
How about you forget reason and allow your emotions to take over?
Or, just hand the reins to me.
I'm in love with Yoon oppa!
Shut up and come with me.
